name: Life Domain (Cleric Subclass - 2024)
description: The Life Domain focuses on the positive energy that helps sustain all life. Clerics of this domain are masters of healing.
source: D&D Beyond Basic Rules 2024 - Cleric Class
domain_spells_note: Life Domain Spells are always prepared and do not count against the number of spells you can prepare each day.

3.name: Disciple of Life
3.description: When a spell you cast with a spell slot restores HP, creature regains additional HP = 2 + spell slot’s level on that turn.

3.name: Life Domain Spells (Level 3)
3.description: Always have Aid, Bless, Cure Wounds, Lesser Restoration prepared.

3.name: Channel Divinity: Preserve Life
3.description: As Magic action, present Holy Symbol, expend Channel Divinity. Restore HP = 5x Cleric level. Choose Bloodied creatures within 30ft, divide HP among them. Can restore creature to no more than half its HP max.

5.name: Life Domain Spells (Level 5)
5.description: Always have Mass Healing Word, Revivify prepared.

6.name: Blessed Healer
6.description: Immediately after casting a spell with a slot that restores HP to others, you regain HP = 2 + spell slot’s level.

7.name: Life Domain Spells (Level 7)
7.description: Always have Aura of Life, Death Ward prepared.

9.name: Life Domain Spells (Level 9)
9.description: Always have Greater Restoration, Mass Cure Wounds prepared.

17.name: Supreme Healing
17.description: When rolling dice to restore HP with a spell or Channel Divinity, use highest number possible for each die instead of rolling.
